name: desktop-claude-code-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code in the Claude desktop app: a dashboard pane, bands above the prompt, panes next to the chat and guards

plugins.name: bro-cockpit
plugins.description: Dashboard pane with overview, files, subagent tree, tool calls, context and rate limit meter, errors and project ideas, plus a git band above the prompt; every tab can be switched off

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks API keys, tokens, private keys and plaintext passwords in Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Bash

plugins.name: branch-guard-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: red warning when you work directly on a protected branch such as main or master. Display only, blocks nothing

plugins.name: env-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: shows the active environment (NODE_ENV, APP_ENV or ENV from the project's .env files) and which .env files exist. Shows and stores no other values

plugins.name: limit-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: the 5-hour limit with its reset countdown (always shown) and the 7-day limit above a threshold

plugins.name: deadline-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: countdown to the project deadline, set with /deadline <date> [text], colored by urgency

plugins.name: daily-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: today's working time, cost, turns and commits, added up across all sessions of the day

plugins.name: prompt-library
plugins.description: Prompt library: saved prompts for all projects or just this one, with search and placeholders, inserted into the prompt box with /p

plugins.name: snippet-pane
plugins.description: Code snippets per project: save with /snippet, pane with language, preview, insert and copy; secrets are redacted

plugins.name: session-summary
plugins.description: Pane with a very short running summary of the session in a language you choose, written by Haiku in small batches while the pane is open from a short digest of each turn. The one mod that spends a little model tokens and sends redacted session excerpts to the model

plugins.name: kanban-pane
plugins.description: Small kanban board per project with open, in progress and done columns: add cards by command, move and delete them in the pane

plugins.name: log-viewer
plugins.description: Pane with the output of the latest Bash calls in this session: command, exit status, duration, output with errors and warnings highlighted, filter and search

plugins.name: dependency-pane
plugins.description: Pane with the project's dependencies from package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml and composer.json, checked with npm outdated at the push of a button

plugins.name: usage-pane
plugins.description: Pane that counts which skills, plugins, connectors (MCP servers) and built-in tools are used, lists what is installed but unused, and estimates the context cost of each, to find what is worth removing
